description.en:
The data set is part of a LCA study on copper products. The study is based on recent industry data supplied by the European copper industry, and thus reflecting the reality in copper semis fabrication. In comparative studies on tubes for various plumbing systems, e.g. drinking water, heating and gas, it is misleading to simply consider the impact of 1 m of tube made from different materials. Plumbing systems are normally designed to transport specified volumes of fluids, with different tube diameters and wall thicknesses required dependent on the choice of material. In addition, consideration must be given to the different design practices, installation and jointing standards and regulatory requirements for each. Many cradle to grave life cycle assessment studies have shown that the environmental aspects from the use and end of life phases of products are often much more significant. The economic value of copper scrap, based on its ability to be recycled 100% without any loss in performance, must be included in comparative assessments.

Technical Purpose: Copper tube is typically used in building and construction sector.

Geographical Representation: EU-15

description.en:
Specific data collection and process modelling were performed in accordance with ISO 14040 and 14044 series. Process related data were collected from 8 production sites for sodium activated bentonite products located in the EU (28) countries + Morocco + Turkey. The data were then consolidated by process stage (horizontal aggregation). The resulting LCI calculation is based on the activated bentonite production process route and corresponds to generic industry screening results. The electricity model used for the project is representative of the average production of the 28 European countries + Morocco + Turkey. Other upstream data are based on European averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the Gabi 6.3.1.14 (PE International) database was used whenever possible and the Ecoinvent 2.2 database as second choice. The Gabi 6.3.1.14 software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for bentonite sodium activated granular.

Synonyms: Bentonite powder

Technical Purpose: Bentonite powder is mainly used:
- as drilling mud
- as binder (e.g. foundry-sand bon, iron ore pelletizer)
- civil engineering (e.g. as groundwater barrier)

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
High data quality. Data collected on site by steel industry experts in accordance with the worldsteel methodology and ISO 14040 standards, and consistency-checked by PE LCA-experts. #Coke, sinter, pellet, hot metal, slab production based on site specific data. #Metallurgical coal data based on global IEA statistics and information from the GaBi database. #Iron ore data obtained from iron ore producer. #Other upstream data based on the GaBi database, including country specific electricity. The LCI does not include any further processing beyond the steelworks gate such as bending, shaping, cutting, welding etc.

Technical Purpose: Obtained by electro plating a thin finished cold rolled coil with a thin layer of tin. It can be found on the market in coil or in sheets and is further processed into finished products by the manufacturers.

Electrolytic tin plated steel is used primarily in food cans, industrial packaging (e.g. small drums)

        dimensional stability. It may also be sterilised by most standard techniques and so finds applications in the medical field. Typical applications are: Housings for domestic

        lighting applications and safety glasses

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
High data quality. Data collected on site by steel industry experts in accordance with the worldsteel methodology and ISO 14040 standards, and consistency-checked by worldsteel LCA-experts. Global coke, sinter, pellet, hot metal, slab production based on wordsteel site specific data. Metallurgical coal data based on global IEA statistics and information from the GaBi database. Iron ore data obtained from iron ore producer. Other upstream data based on the GaBi database, including country specific electricity. The LCI does not include any further processing beyond the steelworks gate such as bending, shaping, cutting, welding etc. The LCI includes credits and burdens associated with end of life recycling, applying a burden to the scrap input and a credit for recycling of the product at end of its life. Therefore, end of life recycling does not need to be modelled separately. Burdens associated with shredding and baling at end of life are not included.

Synonyms: Steel hot rolled coil (HRC)

Technical Purpose: Steel coil rolled on a hot-strip mill. It can be found on the market in coil or in sheets and is further processed into finished
        products by the manufacturers. The various types of hot rolled steel have applications in virtually all sectors of industry: transport, construction, shipbuilding, gas
        containers, pressure vessels, energy pipelines, etc. Hot rolled steel sheet with an anti-slip surface and a diamond or teardrop pattern are typically used for stairs,
        industrial floors and tailboards for goods vehicles.

Geographical Representation: GLO

description.en:
Process-related data were collected from 9 European glass fibre production sites in accordance with ISO 14040. Specific electricity grid models were used for each country where plants are located. Other upstream data are based on global averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the DEAM and EcoInvent databases have been used. The TEAM software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for dry chopped strands of continuous glass fibre.

Technical Purpose: Continuous filament glass fibre are used in the reinforcement of thermosetting and thermoplastic resins in a wide variety of applications: 
• the automotive and transport sectors, 
• the electrical/electronics industry, 
• the construction industry. 
• Other markets for composite materials include pipes and tanks, agricultural equipment, industrial machinery, wind-turbine blades and the sports, leisure and marine sectors.

description.en:
Good overall data quality. Energy carrier mix information based on official statistical information including import / export. A detailed heat plant model was used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Energy carrier extraction and processing data is of sufficient to good (e.g. refinery) data quality. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: PL

description.en:
Specific data collection and process modelling were performed in accordance with ISO 14040 and 14044 series. Process-related data were collected on 8 mineral production sites located in 6 European countries + Turkey .The data were then consolidated by process stage (horizontal aggregation). The resulting LCI calculation is based on the production process route of very fine milled silica sand and corresponds to generic industry screening results. The electricity model used for the project is representative of the average production of the 27 European countries + Turkey. Other upstream data are based on global averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the DEAM database has been used. The TEAM software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for very fine milled silica sand.

Technical Purpose: - Glass fibre and specialty glass. - Building materials - Ceramics - Filler in coatings and polymers

Geographical Representation: EU-27

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: SI

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: EU-27

- environmental protection (e.g. flue gas treatment, waste water treatment, treatment of organic and inorganic waste),
- construction (bricks, mortar, ...) and civil engineering (stabilisation of clayed soils),
- production of precipitated calcium carbonate for the paper industry,
- agriculture,                                                                                                                                                                          - food and chemical industries

description.en:
Specific data collection and process modelling were performed in accordance with ISO 14040 and 14044 series. Process related data were collected on 13 GCC production sites located in 7 European countries + Norway + Turkey. The data were then consolidated by process stage (horizontal aggregation). The resulting LCI calculation is based on the GCC slurry production process route and corresponds to generic industry screening results. The electricity model used for the project is representative of the average production of the 27 European countries + Norway + Turkey. Other upstream data are based on European averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the Gabi 6.3.1.14 (PE International) database was used whenever possible and the Ecoinvent 2.2 database as second choice. The Gabi 6.3.1.14 software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for GCC slurry.

Synonyms: GCC slurry

Technical Purpose: GCC slurry is used as:
- filler or coating agent in paper
- filler in plastics such as PVC, unsaturated polyesters, propylene and polyethylene
- filler in paints and coatings
- rubber

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
The European average Waste-to-Energy plant (WtE) is defined based on the treatment of average European municipal solid waste (MSW). The thermal treatment of a single waste fraction like paper or plastic or even specific wastes like Polyamide 6 is not done in reality in a WtE plant for MSW. The waste is always homogenized to obtain a relative constant calorific value and to comply with the emission standards. Nonetheless the used model and the used settings for the average MSW allows to attribute the environmental burden (emissions and also resource consumption of auxiliaries) energy production as well as the credits (metal scrap export) to a single fraction or specific waste incinerated within an average MSW. Therefore the LCI data is valid for the treatment of the specific waste within an average MSW (the waste fraction share of the MSW is shown in the pie chart beneath, the elementary composition in the first table beneath). The following technology description explains the settings and technology of the average WtE plant used to generate the LCI data set. The net calorific value and the elementary composition of the waste fraction or specific waste are shown in the tables beneath (see corresponding column in the tables). The data set covers all relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented cradle to gate inventory with a good overall data quality. The inventory is mainly based on industry data and is completed, where necessary, by secondary data.

Synonyms: Waste-to-energy of untreated wood (10,7% water content)

Technical Purpose: Standard end-of-life treatment service for a specific waste fraction via thermal treatment.

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: FR

description.en:
The data set covers all relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented cradle to gate inventory with a good overall data quality.  The inventory is mainly based on industry data and is completed, where necessary, by secondary data. End-of-life recycling stage is not included in the cradle-to-gate inventory. The recycled content of the products is 35.9% taking into account recovered paper as well as post-consumer recycling of plasterboard and FGD gypsum (fluegas desulphurisation gypsum) both replacing natural gypsum stone. This indicator specifies the advantages of the use of recycled material on resource depletion and land use not integrated in the mandatory assessments under the ISO 14040 series.

Technical Purpose: Standard mineral product used as dry mortarless contruction material in-doors with standard size (12.5mm thick, 1200mm x
        2400mm)

description.en:
Raw data for polymerization and intermediate products are collected by several producers in Europe; the average is calculated by the consultant based on the production capacity of the companies. The LCI result is calculated with background data from the Boustead database. Suspension PVC accounts for more than 80% of the PVC market. In practice the polymer used in production contains stabilisers and fillers/pigments (rigid PVC). The soft PVC also contains plasticises.

Synonyms: Vinyl dichloride, vinyl chloride

Technical Purpose: Vinyl dichloride (C2H3Cl) is used almost exclusively in the production of polyvinylchloride (PVC) and polyvinylidene chloride
        (PVdC). It is frequently referred to as VCM (vinyl chloride monomer).

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
Process-related data were collected from 7 European glass fibre production sites in accordance with ISO 14040. Specific electricity grid models were used for each country where plants are located. Other upstream data are based on global averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the DEAM and EcoInvent databases have been used. The TEAM software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for wet chopped strands of continuous glass fibre.

Technical Purpose: Wet chopped strands of continuous filament glass fibre are used in the reinforcement of thermosetting and thermoplastic resins in a wide variety of applications: 
• the automotive and transport sectors, 
• the electrical/electronics industry, 
• the construction industry. 
• Other markets for composite materials include pipes and tanks, agricultural equipment, industrial machinery, wind-turbine blades and the sports, leisure and marine sectors.

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
Good overall data quality. Energy carrier mix information based on official statistical information including import / export. A detailed heat plant model was used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Energy carrier extraction and processing data is of sufficient to good (e.g. refinery) data quality. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
Good data quality. Data collected on site by experts from the container glass industry in accordance with the FEVE methodology and ISO 14040 standards, and consistency-checked by LCA-experts from PE International. GaBi database used for upstream data on energy and materials. Upstream data on soda adapted based on discussions with Solvay.

Technical Purpose: The function of products made using glass would be to store and contain liquids and/or solids (e.g. wine, jam, beer, spirits, non
        alcoholic beverages, food, etc). Production of specialty flacconage, cosmetic, pharmaceutical and perfume glass containers was excluded from this
        study.

Geographical Representation: RER

title.de: Behälterglas (Lieferung an den Endverbraucher des enthaltenen Produkts, Wiederverwendungsrate: 7 %); Technologiemix; Produktionsmix im Werk (Standort: Restfehlerquote)

title.pt: Vidro contentor (entregue ao utilizador final do produto contido, taxa de reutilização: 7 %); combinação de tecnologias; Mistura de produção na instalação (Localização: RER)

title.hr: Staklo za spremnike (isporučeno krajnjem korisniku sadržanog proizvoda, stopa ponovne uporabe: 7 %); kombinacija tehnologija; proizvodna mješavina u pogonu (lokacija: stopa preostale pogreške)
title.lv: Stikls tarā (piegādāts galalietotājam, atkalizmantošanas rādītājs: 7 %); tehnoloģiju kombinācija; ražošanas maisījums ražotnē (atrašanās vieta: RER)
title.fr: Verre de conteneur (livré à l’utilisateur final du produit contenu, taux de réutilisation: 7 %); la combinaison de technologies; mix de production à l’usine (localisation: TER)
title.hu: Konténerüveg (a benne lévő termék végfelhasználójának szállítva, újrahasználati arány: 7%); technológiamix; Gyártási szerkezet az üzemben (Hely: fennmaradó hibaarány)
title.uk: Контейнерне скло (доставляється кінцевому споживачеві продукту, що міститься, норма повторного використання: 7%); технологічна суміш; виробнича суміш на заводі (розташування: RER)
title.sk: Kontajnerové sklo (dodávané koncovému používateľovi obsiahnutého výrobku, miera opätovného použitia: 7 %); technologický mix; výrobný mix v závode (miesto: RER)
title.sl: Steklo v vsebnikih (dostavljeno končnemu uporabniku vsebovanega izdelka, stopnja ponovne uporabe: 7 %); mešanica tehnologij; mešanica proizvodov v obratu (lokacija: stopnja preostale napake)
title.ga: Gloine coimeádáin (a sheachadtar chuig úsáideoir deiridh an táirge imshrianta, ráta athúsáide: 7%); meascán teicneolaíochta; meascán táirgthe ag an ngléasra (Suíomh: RER)
title.sv: Containerglas (levereras till slutanvändaren av den inneslutna produkten, återanvändningsgrad: 7 %), Teknikmix. Produktionsmix vid anläggningen (plats: procentsatsen för kvarstående fel)
title.mt: Ħġieġ tal-kontenituri (mogħti lill-utent finali tal-prodott kontenut, rata ta’ użu mill-ġdid: 7 %); taħlita teknoloġika; taħlita tal-produzzjoni fl-impjant (Post: RER)
title.el: Γυαλί δοχείου (παραδίδεται στον τελικό χρήστη του περιορισμένου προϊόντος, ποσοστό επαναχρησιμοποίησης: 7 %)· μείγμα τεχνολογίας· μείγμα παραγωγής στη μονάδα (Τοποθεσία: ΥΠΣ)
title.en: Container glass (delivered to the end user of the contained product, reuse rate: 7%); technology mix; production mix at plant (Location: RER)
title.it: Vetro del contenitore (consegnato all'utilizzatore finale del prodotto contenuto, tasso di riutilizzo: 7%); mix tecnologico; mix di produzione presso l'impianto (ubicazione: TER)
title.es: Vidrio del envase (entregado al usuario final del producto contenido, tasa de reutilización: 7 %); combinación de tecnologías; mezcla de producción en planta (Ubicación: RER)
title.et: Konteinerklaas (tarnitakse suletud pakendis oleva toote lõppkasutajale, korduskasutamise määr: 7%); tehnoloogiakombinatsioon; tootmiskombinatsioon tehases (asukoht: allesjäänud veamäär)
title.cs: Kontejnerové sklo (dodávané konečnému uživateli obsaženého výrobku, míra opětovného použití: 7 %); technologická skladba; výrobní směs v závodě (Místo: míra zbytkových chyb)
title.pl: Szkło w pojemniku (dostarczane użytkownikowi końcowemu zawartego produktu, wskaźnik ponownego użycia: 7%); koszyk technologii; mieszanka produkcyjna w zakładzie (miejsce: poziom błędu resztowego)
title.da: Beholderglas (leveret til slutbrugeren af det indeholdte produkt, genbrugsprocent: 7 %) teknologimiks produktionsmiks på anlægget (placering: restfejlfrekvens)
title.ro: Sticlă pentru recipiente (livrată utilizatorului final al produsului conținut, rata de reutilizare: 7 %); mixul tehnologic; mixul de producție la fabrică (locația: RER)
title.nl: Containerglas (geleverd aan de eindgebruiker van het ingeperkte product, hergebruikpercentage: 7%); technologiemix; productiemix in de fabriek (locatie: RFP)

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
A detailed model of a wall-mounted natural gas condensing boiler was used. The data set covers all relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented cradle to gate inventory with a good overall data quality.

Technical Purpose: Heat on a temperature level of ca. 55°C at the outlet of the heating system with the purpose of residential
        heating.

Geographical Representation: EU-27

description.en:
The data set covers all relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented cradle to gate inventory with a good overall data quality. The inventory is mainly based on industry data and is completed, where necessary, by secondary data. Normally ground water is cleaner than the surface water. Regularly ground water assimilates iron, manganese, carbon dioxide and many different minerals on its way through the soil layers. Although these substances are not harmful, they might worsen water taste or deposit in the pipelines.

Technical Purpose: Potable water from groundwater for all kind of applications.

Geographical Representation: RER

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
The data set covers all relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented end-of-life inventory with a good overall data quality. The inventory is mainly based on industry data and is completed, where necessary, by secondary data.

Technical Purpose: Treatment for waste water (slightly organic contaminated) from industrial processes.

Geographical Representation: EU-27

title.de: Abwasserbehandlung; industrielles Abwasser gemäß der Richtlinie 91/271/EWG über die Behandlung von kommunalem Abwasser; in der Abwasserbehandlungsanlage; leicht organisch kontaminiert (Standort: EU-27)

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
Specific data collection and process modelling were performed in accordance with ISO 14040 and 14044 series. Process related data were collected on 14 PCC production sites located in 7 European countries + Norway + Turkey. The data were then consolidated by process stage (horizontal aggregation). The resulting LCI calculation is based on the PCC slurry production process route and corresponds to generic industry screening results. The electricity model used for the project is representative of the average production of the 27 European countries + Norway + Turkey. Other upstream data are based on European averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the Gabi 6.3.1.14 (PE International) database was used whenever possible and the Ecoinvent 2.2 database as second choice. The Gabi 6.3.1.14 software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for PCC slurry.

Synonyms: PCC slurry

Technical Purpose: PCC slurry is used as filler in:
- filler or coating agent in paper
- filler in polymers

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
The European average Waste-to-Energy plant (WtE) is defined based on the treatment of average European municipal solid waste (MSW). The thermal treatment of a single waste fraction like paper or plastic or even specific wastes like Polyamide 6 is not done in reality in a WtE plant for MSW. The waste is always homogenized to obtain a relative constant calorific value and to comply with the emission standards. Nonetheless the used model and the used settings for the average MSW allows to attribute the environmental burden (emissions and also resource consumption of auxiliaries) energy production as well as the credits (metal scrap export) to a single fraction or specific waste incinerated within an average MSW. Therefore the LCI data is valid for the treatment of the specific waste within an average MSW (the waste fraction share of the MSW is shown in the pie chart beneath, the elementary composition in the first table beneath). The following technology description explains the settings and technology of the average WtE plant used to generate the LCI data set. The net calorific value and the elementary composition of the waste fraction or specific waste are shown in the tables beneath (see corresponding column in the tables). The data set covers all relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented cradle to gate inventory with a good overall data quality. The inventory is mainly based on industry data and is completed, where necessary, by secondary data.

Synonyms: Waste-to-energy of plastics (PE, PP, PS, PB)

Technical Purpose: Standard end-of-life treatment service for a specific waste fraction via thermal treatment.

Geographical Representation: EU-27

description.en:
High data quality. Data collected on site by steel industry experts in accordance with the worldsteel methodology and ISO 14040 standards, and consistency-checked by worldsteel LCA-experts. Global coke, sinter, pellet, hot metal, slab production based on wordsteel site specific data. Metallurgical coal data based on global IEA statistics and information from the GaBi database. Iron ore data obtained from iron ore producer. Other upstream data based on the GaBi database, including country specific electricity. The LCI does not include any further processing beyond the steelworks gate such as bending, shaping, cutting, welding etc.

Synonyms: Steel hot rolled coil (HRC)

Technical Purpose: Steel coil rolled on a hot-strip mill. It can be found on the market in coil or in sheets and is further processed into finished
        products by the manufacturers. The various types of hot rolled steel have applications in virtually all sectors of industry: transport, construction, shipbuilding, gas
        containers, pressure vessels, energy pipelines, etc. Hot rolled steel sheet with an anti-slip surface and a diamond or teardrop pattern are typically used for stairs,
        industrial floors and tailboards for goods vehicles.

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
Process-related data were collected from 5 European glass fibre production sites in accordance with ISO 14040. Specific electricity grid models were used for each country where plants are located. Other upstream data are based on global averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the DEAM and EcoInvent databases have been used. The TEAM software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for continuous glass fibre.

Technical Purpose: Continuous filament glass fibre are used in the reinforcement of thermosetting and thermoplastic resins in a wide variety of applications: 
- the automotive and transport sectors, 
- the electrical/electronics industry, 
- the construction industry. 
- Other markets for composite materials include pipes and tanks, agricultural equipment, industrial machinery, wind-turbine blades and the sports, leisure and marine sectors.

Geographical Representation: RER

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

description.en:
Raw data for polymerization and intermediate products are collected by several producers in Europe; the average is calculated by the consultant based on the production capacity of the companies. The LCI result is calculated with background data from the Boustead database.

Synonyms: PA 66 glass filled, Nylon 66 glass filled

Technical Purpose: About two thirds of the nylon produced in Europe is used for fibres (textiles, carpets, etc.) while most of the remainder is used in
        injection moulded components (automotive parts, consumer goods, etc.) Other smaller uses are films and filaments. Nylon 66 is often selected for use because of its
        combination of toughness, stiffness, high melting point and chemical resistance. It is a relatively easy polymer to modify, so the range of different nylon resins available
        is wider than for most other polymers. Typical modifiers are flame retardants to reduce flammability, rubber to improve impact resistance and glass or minerals to improve
        stiffness and dimensional stability

Geographical Representation: RER

The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: AT

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: RO

description.en:
Process-related data were collected from 8 European glass fibre production sites in accordance with ISO 14040. Specific electricity grid models were used for each country where plants are located. Other upstream data are based on global averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the DEAM and EcoInvent databases have been used. The TEAM software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for dry chopped strands of continuous glass fibre.

Technical Purpose: Continuous filament glass fibre are used in the reinforcement of thermosetting and thermoplastic resins in a wide variety of applications: 
- the automotive and transport sectors, 
- the electrical/electronics industry, 
- the construction industry. 
- Other markets for composite materials include pipes and tanks, agricultural equipment, industrial machinery, wind-turbine blades and the sports, leisure and marine sectors.

Geographical Representation: RER

Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

title.es: Centro Común de Investigación

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of medium voltage (1kV - 60kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: LV

description.en:
Good data quality. Data collected on site by steel industry experts in accordance with the IISI methodology and ISO 14040 standards, and consistency-checked by worldsteel LCA-experts. DEAM database used for upstream electricity data. DEAM data modified by worldsteel for Iron Ore by direct contact with 4 Iron Ore Mining Companies. Global coke production was based on worldsteel site specific data, for 28 coke making plants. An update of the data is being carried out in 2007/2008.

Technical Purpose: A steel section rolled in a hot rolling mill. Steel section includes I-beams, H-beams, wide-flange beams, and sheet piling. It can
        be found on the market for direct use. This product is used in construction, multi-story buildings, industrial buildings, bridge trusses, vertical highway supports, and
        riverbank reinforcement.

description.en:
Process-related data were collected from 6 European glass fibre production sites in accordance with ISO 14040. Specific electricity grid models were used for each country where plants are located. Other upstream data are based on global averages. For modelling and other upstream processes and materials, the DEAM and EcoInvent databases have been used. The TEAM software has been used to generate this ELCD data set for wet chopped strands of continuous glass fibre.

Technical Purpose: Wet chopped strands of continuous filament glass fibre are used in the reinforcement of thermosetting and thermoplastic resins in a wide variety of applications: 
- the automotive and transport sectors, 
- the electrical/electronics industry, 
- the construction industry. 
- Other markets for composite materials include pipes and tanks, agricultural equipment, industrial machinery, wind-turbine blades and the sports, leisure and marine sectors.

Geographical Representation: RER

description.en:
Data sets represents the average country or region specific electricity supply for final consumers, including own consumption, net losses and imports from neighbouring countries. The national energy carrier mixes used for electricity production as well as data about effciencies, net losses and own consumption are taken from official statistics (mainly International Energy Agency) for the relevant reference year. Detailed power plant models were used, which combine measured emissions plus calculated values for not measured emissions of e.g. organics or heavy metals. Inventory is partly based on primary industry data, partly on secondary literature data.

Synonyms: Power grid mix

Technical Purpose: Provision of low voltage (<1kV) electricity for final consumers.

Geographical Representation: AT

description.de: Diese Datenbank (2004) ist die einzige harmonisierte Bodendatenbank für Europa, die sich auch auf Eurasien erstreckt. Es enthält eine geografische Bodendatenbank SGDBE (Polygone), der eine Reihe wesentlicher Bodenattribute beigefügt sind, und eine assoziierte Datenbank PTRDB mit Attributen, deren Werte durch Pedotransfer-Regeln abgeleitet wurden. Teil der Datenbank ist auch die Analytische Bodenprofildatenbank, die gemessene und geschätzte Bodenprofile für Europa enthält.
description.fi: Tämä tietokanta (2004) on Euroopan ainoa yhdenmukaistettu maaperätietokanta, joka ulottuu myös Euraasiaan. Se sisältää maaperän maantieteellisen tietokannan SGDBE (polygonit), johon on liitetty useita olennaisia maaperän ominaisuuksia, ja liitännäistietokannan PTRDB, jossa on ominaisuuksia, jotka on johdettu pedosiirtosääntöjen avulla. Tietokantaan kuuluu myös maaperäprofiilien analyysitietokanta, joka sisältää Euroopan mitatut ja arvioidut maaperäprofiilit.
description.pt: Esta base de dados (2004) é a única base de dados harmonizada do solo para a Europa, estendendo-se também à Eurásia. Contém uma base de dados geográfica do solo SGDBE (polígonos), à qual estão associados vários atributos essenciais do solo, e uma base de dados associada PTRDB, com atributos cujos valores foram obtidos através de regras de pedotransferência. Também faz parte da base de dados a base de dados analítica dos perfis de solo, que contém perfis de solo medidos e estimados para a Europa.
description.bg: Тази база данни (2004 г.) е единствената хармонизирана база данни за почвите в Европа, която обхваща и Евразия. Той съдържа географска база данни за почвите SGDBE (полигони), към която са прикрепени редица съществени почвени атрибути, и свързана база данни PTRDB с атрибути, чиито стойности са получени чрез правила за педотрансфер. Част от базата данни е и Аналитичната база данни за почвени профили, която съдържа измерени и оценени почвени профили за Европа.
description.lt: Ši duomenų bazė (2004 m.) yra vienintelė suderinta Europos dirvožemio duomenų bazė, apimanti ir Euraziją. Ją sudaro dirvožemio geografinė duomenų bazė SGDBE (polygons), prie kurios priskiriami tam tikri esminiai dirvožemio požymiai, ir susijusi duomenų bazė PTRDB, kurios požymiai nustatyti pagal pedotransfer taisykles. Dalis duomenų bazės taip pat yra Dirvožemio profilio analizės duomenų bazė, kurioje pateikiami išmatuoti ir įvertinti Europos dirvožemio profiliai.
description.lv: Šī datubāze (2004. gads) ir vienīgā saskaņotā augsnes datubāze Eiropā, kas aptver arī Eirāziju. Tajā ir augsnes ģeogrāfiskā datubāze SGDBE (poligoni), kurai ir pievienoti vairāki būtiski augsnes atribūti, un saistītā datubāze PTRDB ar atribūtiem, kuru vērtības ir iegūtas, izmantojot pedotransfer noteikumus. Datubāzes daļa ir arī Augsnes profila analītiskā datubāze, kas satur izmērītos un aplēstos augsnes profilus Eiropai.
description.hr: Ta baza podataka (2004.) jedina je usklađena baza podataka o tlu za Europu, koja se proteže i na Euroaziju. Sadrži geografsku bazu podataka tla SGDBE (poligoni) kojoj je pridružen niz bitnih atributa tla i povezanu bazu podataka PTRDB, s atributima koji su izvedeni kroz pravila pedotransfera. Dio baze podataka je i Analitička baza podataka o profilu tla, koja sadržava izmjerene i procijenjene profile tla za Europu.
description.fr: Cette base de données (2004) est la seule base de données harmonisée sur les sols pour l'Europe, qui s'étend également à l'Eurasie. Il contient une base de données géographique du sol SGDBE (polygones) à laquelle un certain nombre d'attributs essentiels du sol sont attachés, et une base de données associée PTRDB, avec des attributs dont les valeurs ont été dérivées par des règles de pédotransfert. La base de données analytique des profils de sol, qui contient des profils de sol mesurés et estimés pour l'Europe, fait également partie de la base de données.
description.hu: Ez az adatbázis (2004) az egyetlen harmonizált talajadatbázis Európában, amely Eurázsiára is kiterjed. Tartalmaz egy talajföldrajzi adatbázist, az SGDBE-t (poligonok), amelyhez számos alapvető talajattribútum kapcsolódik, valamint egy társított adatbázist, a PTRDB-t, amelynek attribútumai a pedotranszfer szabályok alapján származtatott értékek. Az adatbázis részét képezi a talajprofil-analitikai adatbázis is, amely Európa mért és becsült talajprofiljait tartalmazza.
description.uk: Ця база даних (2004) є єдиною гармонізованою базою даних ґрунту для Європи, що поширюється також на Євразію. Він містить ґрунтову географічну базу даних SGDBE (полігони), до якої додається ряд важливих атрибутів ґрунту, та асоційовану базу даних PTRDB, з атрибутами, значення яких були отримані за допомогою правил педотрансферу. Також частиною бази даних є Аналітична база даних профілю ґрунту, яка містить виміряні та оцінені профілі ґрунту для Європи.
description.sk: Táto databáza (2004) je jedinou harmonizovanou databázou pôdy pre Európu, ktorá sa rozširuje aj do Eurázie. Obsahuje geografickú databázu pôdy SGDBE (polygóny), ku ktorej je pripojených niekoľko základných pôdnych atribútov, a súvisiacu databázu PTRDB s atribútmi, ktorých hodnoty boli odvodené prostredníctvom pravidiel pedotransferu. Súčasťou databázy je aj analytická databáza pôdnych profilov, ktorá obsahuje namerané a odhadované pôdne profily pre Európu.
description.sl: Ta zbirka podatkov (2004) je edina usklajena zbirka podatkov o tleh za Evropo, ki zajema tudi Evrazijo. Vsebuje geografsko podatkovno zbirko tal SGDBE (poligoni), ki so ji priloženi številni bistveni atributi tal, in povezano podatkovno zbirko PTRDB z atributi, katerih vrednosti so bile izpeljane s pravili o pedotransferju. Del podatkovne zbirke je tudi analitična podatkovna zbirka profilov tal, ki vsebuje izmerjene in ocenjene profile tal za Evropo.
description.ga: Is é an bunachar sonraí (2004) seo an t-aon bhunachar sonraí comhchuibhithe ithreach don Eoraip, a shíneann chuig an Eoráise freisin. Tá bunachar sonraí geografach ithreach SGDBE (polagáin) ann lena gceanglaítear roinnt tréithe riachtanacha ithreach, agus bunachar sonraí comhlachaithe PTRDB, lena ngabhann tréithe a díorthaíodh trí rialacha pedotransfer. Cuid den bhunachar sonraí freisin is ea an Bunachar Sonraí Anailíseach maidir le Próifíl Ithreach, ina bhfuil próifílí ithreach tomhaiste agus measta don Eoraip.
description.sv: Denna databas (2004) är den enda harmoniserade markdatabasen för Europa och omfattar även Eurasien. Den innehåller en geografisk markdatabas SGDBE (polygoner) till vilken ett antal väsentliga markattribut är knutna, och en associerad databas PTRDB, med attribut som värden har härletts genom pedotransferregler. En annan del av databasen är databasen för analys av markprofiler, som innehåller uppmätta och uppskattade markprofiler för Europa.
description.mt: Din il-bażi tad-data (2004) hija l-unika bażi tad-data armonizzata dwar il-ħamrija għall-Ewropa, li testendi wkoll għall-Ewrasja. Fih bażi tad-data ġeografika tal-ħamrija SGDBE (poligoni) li magħha huma mehmuża għadd ta’ attributi essenzjali tal-ħamrija, u bażi tad-data assoċjata PTRDB, b’attributi li l-valuri tagħhom ġew derivati permezz ta’ regoli ta’ pedotrasferiment. Barra minn hekk, parti mill-bażi tad-data hija l-Bażi tad-Data Analitika tal-Profil tal-Ħamrija, li fiha profili tal-ħamrija mkejla u stmati għall-Ewropa.
description.el: Αυτή η βάση δεδομένων (2004) είναι η μόνη εναρμονισμένη βάση δεδομένων εδάφους για την Ευρώπη, η οποία εκτείνεται και στην Ευρασία. Περιέχει μια γεωγραφική βάση δεδομένων εδάφους SGDBE (πολύγωνα) στην οποία συνδέονται ορισμένα βασικά χαρακτηριστικά του εδάφους, καθώς και μια συνδεδεμένη βάση δεδομένων PTRDB, με χαρακτηριστικά τα οποία οι τιμές έχουν προκύψει μέσω κανόνων παιδομεταφοράς. Επίσης, μέρος της βάσης δεδομένων είναι η βάση δεδομένων ανάλυσης προφίλ εδάφους, η οποία περιέχει μετρημένα και εκτιμώμενα προφίλ εδάφους για την Ευρώπη.
description.en: This database (2004) is the only harmonized soil database for Europe, extending also to Eurasia. It contains a soil geographical database SGDBE (polygons) to which a number of essential soil attributes are attached, and an associate database PTRDB, with attributes which values have been derived through pedotransfer rules. Also part of the database is the Soil Profile Analytical Database, that contains measured and estimated soil profiles for Europe.
description.it: Questa banca dati (2004) è l'unica banca dati armonizzata del suolo per l'Europa, che si estende anche all'Eurasia. Contiene un database geografico del suolo SGDBE (poligoni) a cui sono collegati una serie di attributi essenziali del suolo e un database associato PTRDB, con attributi che sono stati derivati attraverso le regole di trasferimento pedologico. Fa parte della banca dati anche la banca dati analitica del profilo del suolo, che contiene profili del suolo misurati e stimati per l'Europa.
description.es: Esta base de datos (2004) es la única base de datos armonizada de suelos para Europa, que se extiende también a Eurasia. Contiene una base de datos geográfica del suelo SGDBE (polígonos) a la que se adjuntan una serie de atributos esenciales del suelo, y una base de datos asociada PTRDB, con atributos cuyos valores se han derivado a través de reglas de pedotransferencia. También forma parte de la base de datos la Base de datos analítica de perfiles de suelos, que contiene perfiles de suelos medidos y estimados para Europa.
description.et: See andmebaas (2004) on Euroopa ainus ühtlustatud mullaandmebaas, mis hõlmab ka Euraasiat. See sisaldab mulla geograafilist andmebaasi SGDBE (polügoonid), millele on lisatud mitu olulist mullaatribuuti, ja sellega seotud andmebaasi PTRDB, mis sisaldab atribuute, mille väärtused on tuletatud pedoülekande eeskirjade alusel. Andmebaasi kuulub ka mullaprofiili analüütiline andmebaas, mis sisaldab mõõdetud ja hinnangulisi mullaprofiile Euroopa kohta.
description.cs: Tato databáze (2004) je jedinou harmonizovanou databází půdy pro Evropu, která zahrnuje i Eurasii. Obsahuje geografickou databázi půdy SGDBE (polygony), k níž je připojena řada základních atributů půdy, a přidruženou databázi PTRDB s atributy, jejichž hodnoty byly odvozeny pomocí pravidel pedotransferu. Součástí databáze je také analytická databáze půdních profilů, která obsahuje měřené a odhadované půdní profily pro Evropu.
description.pl: Ta baza danych (2004) jest jedyną zharmonizowaną bazą danych gleb w Europie, obejmującą również Eurazję. Zawiera geograficzną bazę danych glebowych SGDBE (poligony), do której dołączono szereg istotnych atrybutów gleby, oraz powiązaną bazę danych PTRDB z atrybutami, których wartości uzyskano za pomocą reguł pedotransferu. Częścią bazy danych jest również analityczna baza danych profilu glebowego, która zawiera zmierzone i szacunkowe profile gleb dla Europy.
description.ro: Această bază de date (2004) este singura bază de date armonizată a solului pentru Europa, extinzându-se și la Eurasia. Acesta conține o bază de date geografică a solului SGDBE (poligoane) la care sunt atașate o serie de atribute esențiale ale solului și o bază de date asociată PTRDB, cu atribute ale căror valori au fost derivate prin reguli de pedotransfer. De asemenea, o parte a bazei de date este baza de date analitică a profilului solului, care conține profiluri de sol măsurate și estimate pentru Europa.
description.da: Denne database (2004) er den eneste harmoniserede jordbundsdatabase for Europa, der også omfatter Eurasien. Den indeholder en geografisk database over jordbunden SGDBE (polygoner), hvortil der er knyttet en række væsentlige jordbundsattributter, og en associeret database PTRDB med attributter, hvis værdier er udledt ved hjælp af pedotransferregler. En del af databasen er også den analytiske database over jordbundsprofiler, som indeholder målte og estimerede jordbundsprofiler for Europa.
description.nl: Deze databank (2004) is de enige geharmoniseerde bodemdatabase voor Europa, die zich ook uitstrekt tot Eurazië. Het bevat een geografische bodemdatabank SGDBE (polygonen) waaraan een aantal essentiële bodemattributen zijn gekoppeld, en een bijbehorende databank PTRDB, met attributen waarvan de waarden zijn afgeleid door middel van pedotransferregels. Ook maakt de database deel uit van de Soil Profile Analytical Database, die gemeten en geschatte bodemprofielen voor Europa bevat.

description.de: GIS-Karten im Zusammenhang mit den Grundwasserressourcen in Europa, die drei Themen abdecken: Bestandsaufnahme der Grundwasserleiter; Hydrogeologie von Grundwasserleitern; Grundwasserentnahme; für 9 europäische Länder (Belgien, Bundesrepublik Deutschland, Dänemark, Frankreich, Irland, Italien, Luxemburg, Niederlande und Vereinigtes Königreich)
description.fi: Euroopan pohjavesivaroihin liittyvät GIS-kartat, jotka kattavat kolme teemaa: akviferien luettelo; akviferien hydrogeologia; pohjavedenotto; 9 Euroopan maata (Alankomaat, Belgia, Irlanti, Italia, Luxemburg, Ranska, Saksa, Tanska ja Yhdistynyt kuningaskunta)
description.pt: Mapas SIG relacionados com os recursos hídricos subterrâneos na Europa, abrangendo três temas: Inventário de aquíferos; Hidrogeologia dos aquíferos; Captação de águas subterrâneas; para 9 países europeus (Bélgica, República Federal da Alemanha, Dinamarca, França, Irlanda, Itália, Luxemburgo, Países Baixos e Reino Unido)
description.bg: ГИС карти, свързани с подземните водни ресурси в Европа, обхващащи 3 теми: Инвентаризация на водоносните хоризонти; Хидрогеология на водоносните хоризонти; водочерпене на подземни води; за 9 европейски държави (Белгия, Федерална република Германия, Дания, Франция, Ирландия, Италия, Люксембург, Нидерландия и Обединеното кралство)
description.lt: GIS žemėlapiai, susiję su Europos požeminio vandens ištekliais, apimantys 3 temas: vandeningųjų sluoksnių aprašas; vandeningųjų sluoksnių hidrogeologija; Požeminio vandens gavyba; 9 Europos šalims (Belgijai, Vokietijos Federacinei Respublikai, Danijai, Prancūzijai, Airijai, Italijai, Liuksemburgui, Nyderlandams ir Jungtinei Karalystei)
description.lv: ĢIS Kartes, kas saistītas ar gruntsūdens resursiem Eiropā, aptverot 3 tēmas: Ūdens nesējslāņu inventarizācija; Ūdens nesējslāņu hidroģeoloģija; Gruntsūdeņu ieguve; deviņām Eiropas valstīm (Beļģijai, Vācijas Federatīvajai Republikai, Dānijai, Francijai, Īrijai, Itālijai, Luksemburgai, Nīderlandei un Apvienotajai Karalistei)
description.hr: Zemljovidi GIS-a povezani s podzemnim vodnim resursima u Europi, koji obuhvaćaju tri teme: Popis vodonosnika; hidrogeologija vodonosnika; zahvaćanje podzemnih voda; za 9 europskih zemalja (Belgija, Savezna Republika Njemačka, Danska, Francuska, Irska, Italija, Luksemburg, Nizozemska i Ujedinjena Kraljevina)
description.fr: Cartes SIG relatives aux ressources en eaux souterraines en Europe, couvrant 3 thèmes: Inventaire des aquifères; Hydrogéologie des aquifères; captage des eaux souterraines; pour 9 pays européens (Belgique, République fédérale d'Allemagne, Danemark, France, Irlande, Italie, Luxembourg, Pays-Bas et Royaume-Uni)
description.hu: Az európai felszín alatti vízkészletekre vonatkozó GIS-térképek, amelyek három témát ölelnek fel: A víztartó rétegek jegyzéke; Víztartó rétegek hidrogeológiája; Felszín alatti vízkivétel; 9 európai ország (Belgium, Németországi Szövetségi Köztársaság, Dánia, Franciaország, Írország, Olaszország, Luxemburg, Hollandia és az Egyesült Királyság) esetében
description.uk: Карти ГІС, пов'язані з ресурсами підземних вод в Європі, охоплюють 3 теми: Інвентаризація водоносних горизонтів; Гідрогеологія водоносних горизонтів; абстракція підземних вод; для 9 європейських країн (Бельгія, Федеративна Республіка Німеччина, Данія, Франція, Ірландія, Італія, Люксембург, Нідерланди та Велика Британія)
description.sk: Mapy GIS týkajúce sa zdrojov podzemnej vody v Európe, ktoré zahŕňajú 3 témy: Zoznam kolektorov podzemnej vody; Hydrogeológia kolektorov podzemnej vody; odber podzemnej vody; pre 9 európskych krajín (Belgicko, Spolková republika Nemecko, Dánsko, Francúzsko, Írsko, Taliansko, Luxembursko, Holandsko a Spojené kráľovstvo)
description.sl: Zemljevidi GIS v zvezi s podzemnimi vodnimi viri v Evropi, ki zajemajo tri teme: popis vodonosnikov; hidrogeologija vodonosnikov; odvzem podzemne vode; za 9 evropskih držav (Belgija, Zvezna republika Nemčija, Danska, Francija, Irska, Italija, Luksemburg, Nizozemska in Združeno kraljestvo)
description.ga: Léarscáileanna GIS a bhaineann le hacmhainní screamhuisce san Eoraip, lena gcumhdaítear 3 théama: Fardal uiscíoch; Hidrigeolaíocht uiscíoch; Astarraingt screamhuisce; i gcás 9 dtír Eorpacha (an Bheilg, Poblacht Chónaidhme na Gearmáine, an Danmhairg, an Fhrainc, Éire, an Iodáil, Lucsamburg, an Ísiltír agus an Ríocht Aontaithe)
description.sv: GIS-kartor med anknytning till grundvattenresurser i Europa, som omfattar tre teman: Förteckning över akviferer. akviferernas hydrogeologi, Uttag av grundvatten. för nio europeiska länder (Belgien, Förbundsrepubliken Tyskland, Danmark, Frankrike, Irland, Italien, Luxemburg, Nederländerna och Förenade kungariket)
description.el: Χάρτες ΣΓΠ που σχετίζονται με τους υπόγειους υδάτινους πόρους στην Ευρώπη, οι οποίοι καλύπτουν 3 θέματα: Απογραφή υδροφόρων οριζόντων· Υδρογεωλογία υδροφόρων οριζόντων· άντληση υπόγειων υδάτων· για 9 ευρωπαϊκές χώρες (Βέλγιο, Ομοσπονδιακή Δημοκρατία της Γερμανίας, Δανία, Γαλλία, Ιρλανδία, Ιταλία, Λουξεμβούργο, Κάτω Χώρες και Ηνωμένο Βασίλειο)

description.it: Mappe GIS relative alle risorse idriche sotterranee in Europa, che coprono 3 temi: Inventario delle falde acquifere; Idrogeologia delle falde acquifere; estrazione delle acque sotterranee; per 9 paesi europei (Belgio, Repubblica federale di Germania, Danimarca, Francia, Irlanda, Italia, Lussemburgo, Paesi Bassi e Regno Unito)
description.es: Mapas SIG relacionados con los recursos de aguas subterráneas en Europa, que abarcan tres temas: Inventario de acuíferos; Hidrogeología de los acuíferos; b) La captación de aguas subterráneas; para 9 países europeos (Bélgica, República Federal de Alemania, Dinamarca, Francia, Irlanda, Italia, Luxemburgo, Países Bajos y Reino Unido)
description.et: Euroopa põhjaveevarudega seotud geoinfosüsteemi kaardid, mis hõlmavad kolme teemat: põhjaveekihtide inventuur; põhjaveekihtide hüdrogeoloogia; põhjavee võtmine; üheksa Euroopa riiki (Belgia, Saksamaa Liitvabariik, Taani, Prantsusmaa, Iirimaa, Itaalia, Luksemburg, Madalmaad ja Ühendkuningriik)
description.cs: Mapy GIS týkající se zdrojů podzemních vod v Evropě, které pokrývají 3 témata: soupis vodonosných vrstev; Hydrogeologie vodonosných vrstev; odběr podzemních vod; pro 9 evropských zemí (Belgie, Spolková republika Německo, Dánsko, Francie, Irsko, Itálie, Lucembursko, Nizozemsko a Spojené království)
description.pl: Mapy GIS dotyczące zasobów wód podziemnych w Europie, obejmujące 3 tematy: Inwentaryzacja warstw wodonośnych; Hydrogeologia warstw wodonośnych; pobór wód podziemnych; dla 9 krajów europejskich (Belgia, Republika Federalna Niemiec, Dania, Francja, Irlandia, Włochy, Luksemburg, Niderlandy i Zjednoczone Królestwo)
description.da: GIS-kort vedrørende grundvandsressourcer i Europa, der dækker tre temaer: Fortegnelse over grundvandsmagasiner Hydrogeologi af grundvandsmagasiner; indvinding af grundvand for 9 europæiske lande (Belgien, Forbundsrepublikken Tyskland, Danmark, Frankrig, Irland, Italien, Luxembourg, Nederlandene og Det Forenede Kongerige)
description.ro: Hărți GIS legate de resursele de apă subterană din Europa, care acoperă 3 teme: Inventarul acviferelor; Hidrogeologia acviferelor; captarea apelor subterane; pentru 9 țări europene (Belgia, Republica Federală Germania, Danemarca, Franța, Irlanda, Italia, Luxemburg, Țările de Jos și Regatul Unit)

description.de: Datensatz, der 3 GIS-Karten enthält, die potenzielle Bedrohungen der biologischen Vielfalt des Bodens in Europa (für Bodenmikroorganismen, für Fauna, für biologische Funktionen) sowie 13 Eingangsschichten (Habitatfragmentierung, Klimawandel, Bodenerosion usw.) zeigen; Auflösung 500m.
description.fi: Tietoaineisto, joka sisältää kolme GIS-karttaa, joista käy ilmi maaperän biologiseen monimuotoisuuteen Euroopassa kohdistuvat mahdolliset uhat (maaperän mikro-organismit, eläimistö, biologiset toiminnot) sekä 13 panoskerrosta (elinympäristön pirstoutuminen, ilmastonmuutos, maaperän eroosio jne.); resoluutio 500m.
description.pt: Conjunto de dados que contém 3 mapas SIG que mostram as potenciais ameaças à biodiversidade do solo na Europa (para os microrganismos do solo, para a fauna, para as funções biológicas), juntamente com 13 camadas de entrada (fragmentação do habitat, alterações climáticas, erosão do solo, etc.); Resolução 500m.
description.bg: Набор от данни, който съдържа 3 ГИС карти, показващи потенциалните заплахи за биологичното разнообразие на почвите в Европа (за почвените микроорганизми, за фауната, за биологичните функции), заедно с 13 входящи слоя (разпокъсаност на местообитанията, изменение на климата, ерозия на почвата и др.); резолюция 500 м.
description.lt: duomenų rinkinys, kurį sudaro 3 GIS žemėlapiai, iš kurių matyti galimos grėsmės Europos dirvožemio biologinei įvairovei (dirvožemio mikroorganizmams, faunai, biologinėms funkcijoms), taip pat 13 įvesties sluoksnių (buveinių suskaidymas, klimato kaita, dirvožemio erozija ir kt.); Rezoliucija 500m.
description.lv: datu kopa, kas satur 3 ĢIS kartes, kurās parādīts potenciālais apdraudējums augsnes bioloģiskajai daudzveidībai Eiropā (augsnes mikroorganismiem, faunai, bioloģiskajām funkcijām), kā arī 13 ievades slāņi (dzīvotņu fragmentācija, klimata pārmaiņas, augsnes erozija utt.); izšķirtspēja 500m.
description.hr: skup podataka koji sadržava tri karte GIS-a koje prikazuju potencijalne prijetnje bioraznolikosti tla u Europi (za mikroorganizme tla, za faunu, forbiološke funkcije), zajedno s 13 ulaznih slojeva (rascjepkanost staništa, klimatske promjene, erozija tla itd.); Rezolucija 500m.
description.fr: Ensemble de données contenant 3 cartes SIG montrant les menaces potentielles pour la biodiversité des sols en Europe (pour les micro-organismes du sol, pour la faune, les fonctions biologiques), ainsi que 13 couches d’intrants (fragmentation de l’habitat, changement climatique, érosion des sols, etc.); résolution 500m.
description.hu: adatkészlet, amely 3 GIS-térképet tartalmaz, amelyek bemutatják az európai talaj biológiai sokféleségét fenyegető potenciális veszélyeket (a talajban élő mikroorganizmusok, az állatvilág és a biológiai funkciók tekintetében), valamint 13 bemeneti réteget (az élőhelyek szétaprózódása, éghajlatváltozás, talajerózió stb.); felbontás 500m.
description.uk: Набір даних, який містить 3 ГІС-карти, що показують потенційні загрози біорізноманіттю ґрунту в Європі (для ґрунтових мікроорганізмів, для фауни, для біологічних функцій), а також 13 вхідних шарів (фрагментація середовища проживання, зміна клімату, ерозія ґрунту тощо); роздільна здатність 500м.
description.sk: súbor údajov, ktorý obsahuje 3 mapy GIS znázorňujúce potenciálne hrozby pre biodiverzitu pôdy v Európe (pre pôdne mikroorganizmy, faunu, forbiologické funkcie) spolu s 13 vstupnými vrstvami (fragmentácia biotopov, zmena klímy, erózia pôdy atď.); Rozlíšenie 500m.
description.sl: nabor podatkov, ki vsebuje 3 zemljevide GIS, ki prikazujejo potencialne grožnje biotski raznovrstnosti tal v Evropi (za mikroorganizme v tleh, za favno, za forbiološke funkcije), skupaj s 13 vhodnimi plastmi (razdrobljenost habitatov, podnebne spremembe, erozija tal itd.); ločljivost 500 m.
description.ga: Tacar sonraí ina bhfuil 3 léarscáil GIS ina léirítear bagairtí féideartha ar bhithéagsúlacht ithreach san Eoraip (do mhiocrorgánaigh ithreach, d’fhána, d’fheidhmeanna bitheolaíocha), mar aon le 13 shraith ionchuir (ilroinnt gnáthóige, an t-athrú aeráide, creimeadh ithreach, etc.); taifeach 500m.
description.sv: Dataset som innehåller tre GIS-kartor som visar potentiella hot mot markens biologiska mångfald i Europa (för markmikroorganismer, för fauna, för biologiska funktioner) tillsammans med 13 insatsskikt (livsmiljöfragmentering, klimatförändringar, markerosion osv.). upplösning 500m.
description.mt: Sett ta’ data li fih 3 mapep tal-GIS li juru Theddid potenzjali għall-bijodiversità tal-ħamrija fl-Ewropa (għall-mikroorganiżmi tal-ħamrija, għall-fawna, għall-funzjonijiet forbijoloġiċi), flimkien ma’ 13-il saff ta’ input (frammentazzjoni tal-ħabitat, tibdil fil-klima, erożjoni tal-ħamrija, eċċ.); riżoluzzjoni 500m.
description.el: Σύνολο δεδομένων που περιέχει 3 χάρτες GIS που παρουσιάζουν πιθανές απειλές για τη βιοποικιλότητα του εδάφους στην Ευρώπη (για μικροοργανισμούς του εδάφους, για την πανίδα, για βιολογικές λειτουργίες), μαζί με 13 στρώματα εισροών (κατακερματισμός οικοτόπων, κλιματική αλλαγή, διάβρωση του εδάφους κ.λπ.)· ψήφισμα 500m.
description.en: Dataset that contains 3 GIS maps showing Potential threats to soil biodiversity in Europe (for soil microorganisms, for fauna,forbiological functions), along with 13 input layers (habitat fragmentation, climate change, soil erosion, etc.); resolution 500m.
description.it: Serie di dati contenente 3 mappe GIS che mostrano le potenziali minacce alla biodiversità del suolo in Europa (per i microrganismi del suolo, per la fauna, per le funzioni biologiche), insieme a 13 strati di input (frammentazione degli habitat, cambiamenti climatici, erosione del suolo, ecc.); Risoluzione 500m.
description.es: Conjunto de datos que contiene tres mapas SIG que muestran las posibles amenazas para la biodiversidad del suelo en Europa (para los microorganismos del suelo, para la fauna, para las funciones biológicas), junto con 13 capas de entrada (fragmentación de hábitats, cambio climático, erosión del suelo, etc.); resolución 500m.
description.et: andmestik, mis sisaldab kolme geoinfosüsteemi kaarti, millel on näidatud võimalikud ohud mulla bioloogilisele mitmekesisusele Euroopas (mulla mikroorganismid, loomastik,forbioloogilised funktsioonid) koos 13 sisendkihiga (elupaikade killustumine, kliimamuutused, mullaerosioon jne); resolutsioon 500m.
description.cs: soubor údajů, který obsahuje 3 mapy GIS znázorňující potenciální hrozby pro biologickou rozmanitost půdy v Evropě (pro půdní mikroorganismy, pro faunu, pro biologické funkce) a 13 vstupních vrstev (roztříštěnost stanovišť, změna klimatu, eroze půdy atd.); Rozlišení 500m.
description.pl: zbiór danych zawierający 3 mapy GIS przedstawiające potencjalne zagrożenia dla różnorodności biologicznej gleby w Europie (w odniesieniu do mikroorganizmów glebowych, fauny, funkcji biologicznych) oraz 13 warstw wejściowych (fragmentacja siedlisk, zmiana klimatu, erozja gleby itp.); rozdzielczość 500m.
description.ro: Set de date care conține 3 hărți GIS care prezintă potențiale amenințări la adresa biodiversității solului în Europa (pentru microorganismele din sol, pentru faună, funcții forbiologice), împreună cu 13 straturi de intrare (fragmentarea habitatelor, schimbările climatice, eroziunea solului etc.); Rezoluția 500m.
description.da: Datasæt, der indeholder 3 GIS-kort, der viser potentielle trusler mod jordbundens biodiversitet i Europa (for jordbundsmikroorganismer, for fauna, for biologiske funktioner) sammen med 13 inputlag (fragmentering af levesteder, klimaændringer, jorderosion osv.) resolution 500m.
description.nl: Dataset met 3 GIS-kaarten met potentiële bedreigingen voor de bodembiodiversiteit in Europa (voor bodemmicro-organismen, voor fauna, voor biologische functies), samen met 13 inputlagen (versnippering van habitats, klimaatverandering, bodemerosie, enz.); resolutie 500m.
